name: DPC stake changes duplicate accrued reward quota
summary: DPC's stakeLp and claimStakeLp add getClaimQuota(account) to oldClaimQuota, but getClaimQuota already returns time-accrued quota plus oldClaimQuota. Each stake change therefore duplicates the existing accrued credit, and credit doubles with every call. claimDpcAirdrop pays that credit in DPC from the contract's reserve, bounded only by the purchased dpcAirdrop allotment and bypassing the LP-stake-by-time vesting. The first duplication is an ordinary stakeLp at block 21178424. The exploiter bought 45 allotments through helper 0x2109bbec, staked dust LP, and repeated claimStakeLp(1 wei). It claimed 22,390 DPC and sold it into the DPC/USDT pair. The seed description incorrectly claimed that elapsed-time accrual was absent.

loss.notes: The exploiter's realised net USDT: the DPC/USDT pair paid 0xf211fa86 78,213.799601795586855413 USDT in three sales of claimed DPC, less the 4,598 USDT that 0xf211fa86 sent to its helper to buy 45 allotments (4,500 USDT) and seed LP. The DPC came from the contract's own reserve through claimDpcAirdrop, so the USDT drained from pair LPs is at least this amount. The helper's residual (about 0.60 USDT and 12.298905560438538 staked LP) is not added. The 70% (ucur1) and 15% (referral) splits of the allotment purchases are not netted back. The seed/Beosin $103,755 is not reproduced and is not used.

ageReset.description: The operator's changeIsClaim(true) opens claimDpcAirdrop, the only path that pays duplicated quota out of the contract reserve (require(isClaim)). Before it, duplicated credit could accrue but never be redeemed. It is the sole isClaim write between deployment and the anchor, and no later configuration touches the quota logic.

sources.note: Anchor, root cause, campaign and loss. Verified source: Etherscan V2 contract.getsourcecode chainid=56, address 0xb75ca3c3e99747d0e2f6e75a9fbd17f5ac03cebe, v0.8.7+commit.e28d00a7, 200 runs; SHA-256 of SourceCode d79f8e9fad9b4686364f13c2aa8a2531d79ef4031dad168fffaf53f97cd09812. stakeLp and claimStakeLp run oldClaimQuota[_from] = oldClaimQuota[_from].add(getClaimQuota(_from)), and getClaimQuota ends with ClaimQuota.add(oldClaimQuota[addr]). claimDpcAirdrop requires isClaim, credits getClaimQuota from _rOwned[address(this)], zeroes oldClaimQuota and subtracts the claim from dpcAirdrop. Each tokenAirdrop (100 USDT) adds 10*IdoPrice DPC of dpcAirdrop. Anchor: debug_traceTransaction(source-11, prestateTracer, diffMode) shows the oldClaimQuota slot keccak256(abi.encode(0x736f9f8f4acf1e46ec9d5a152022a4a5906656e3, 0x4e)) = 0xc7b1266c...b4a1 changing from 4667785272954 to 1647380116041453. eth_call getClaimQuota(0x736f9f8f) at block 21178423 returns 1641144824026398, which already includes the prior 4667785272954, so that credit is counted twice. A prior successful stake at block 21177384 created it. Etherscan account.txlist for the token over blocks 21120156-21190000 gives 1,742 direct transactions. The state diffs of all 35 successful direct stakeLp/claimStakeLp transactions before block 21179254 show no earlier positive duplication. LP Transfer logs over [21120156, 21179552] show the only earlier indirect stake is helper setup 0x0a9158bd93e505c019d687ea64a2f2a9032178ee07dd3f23783bb7a8a5f2ce1c (block 21179222). Campaign: helper 0x2109bbecb0a563e204985524dd3db2f6254ab419 has 12 transactions (account.txlist, blocks 0-21220000). 0x4d9a4b90c0916e547b86dc3df52aeffede0a8b6d59ac16febc50babeef943f15 (block 21179209) and 0x6f059f35c45caab499466a07afe8434606296f367b292a1154cd68927c8d30de make 42 + 3 tokenAirdrop purchases (4,200 + 300 USDT). 0x0a9158bd adds 50 + 47.40330721507801 USDT of liquidity and stakes 12.298905560438538 LP. Source-5 (block 21179254) makes 27 successful claimStakeLp(1 wei) calls; attempt 0x253666db7ccc770d3b2ce33e40192f11adb0a1680e693728ca7d6db7f704db1e reverts. Etherscan getLogs for DPC Transfer with from = DPC contract over blocks 21175413-21300000 gives 1,118 transfers totalling 31,881.82 DPC. The helper receives 20602.126197290067450867, 1397.5977031032692013 and 390.331241699480614767 DPC in source-6 (block 21179285), source-7 (block 21179487) and source-1 (block 21179552); no other recipient exceeds 135.1 DPC. USDT Transfer logs in the same three receipts pay 75664.535267446184667697, 2001.517797961483091691 and 547.746536387919096025 from pair 0x79cd24ed4524373af6e047556018b1440cf04be3 to 0xf211fa86cbc60d693d687075b03dff3c225b25c9. Etherscan tokentx for 0xf211fa86 over blocks 21100000-21300000 lists only those three inflows and outflows of 4,300 (0x9cfa3425bfb3..., block 21179198) and 298 USDT to the helper. Net 73615.799601795586855413 USDT, at par.

Target identity and age. Source-9 receipt: top-level creation of 0xb75ca3c3 by 0x8e59424663e6ba2327564b28437b6e0294a4725c at block 21120156, index 259. keccak256(eth_getCode) is empty at 21120155 and 0x9bb3a2d7... at 21120156, 21175413 and 21178423. It sets no EIP-1967 slot, and all ten DELEGATECALL sites target the PUSH20 external library 0xff7a90fa8193b51482c37e84f3e9a0798921380b (same creator, five blocks earlier, byte-identical over the window), so the artifact is fixed. isClaim() (0x25ffeea0) is 0 at blocks 21120156 and 21175412 and 1 at 21175413. Source-8 (index 91) is changeIsClaim(true) from poperator 0xf58309ec357119fcaa2a619b72130b7c2568ebc1 (the hard-coded poperator); its prestate diff changes slot 0x53 from 0 to 1. The token's 1,742 direct transactions over blocks 21120156-21190000, by selector: 1085 claimDpcRest, 444 approve, 101 stakeLp, 64 transfer, 19 owner setAirdrop, 9 tokenAirdrop, 8 claimStakeLp, 4 owner setallInviter, 2 claimDpcAirdrop, 2 inviterSet, 1 owner updateLimitedall, 1 changeIsClaim and 1 plain transfer. setAirdrop/setallInviter only assign allotments and referrers; updateLimitedall (block 21120528) precedes source-8. So claim activation is the latest change that makes duplicated quota redeemable. Stake/unstake duplication itself is reachable from deployment, but it pays nothing until isClaim is set. This follows the trading-activation basis used for gated token defects.
